note: Trinidad and Tobago: nationals of the countries listed enter without a visa for 90 days (90 in 180 for the Schengen states and the EU but Ireland) or 30; Australians, New Zealanders and Filipinos get a waiver of the visa on arrival (TT$400). Everyone else who needs a visa may apply for an e-Visa online. The waiver on arrival with immigration's prior approval, and Timatic's longer list of nationalities eligible on arrival, aren't modelled. Read from Wikipedia's copy. Read on 2026-11-03 against the Ministry of Homeland Security's own list of the countries whose citizens don't need an entry visa (19 September 2024): it names 42, mostly of the Commonwealth, gives no lengths, and doesn't present itself as the whole list (it leaves out the United States, the Schengen states and Latin America, which Wikipedia's copy has as visa-free), so it is silent on the rest; every figure stands on Wikipedia's copy.

Citizens of Australia , New Zealand and Philippines may obtain "Waiver of the Visa" on arrival at a cost of TT$ 400. ... Citizens of other countries that require a visa may obtain an eVisa online.
